title: DE-07/2024/090 - Departmental Tests - July, 2024 [Translation from English to Tamil and Translation from Tamil to English] (Time 2 hours, 100 marks)
questions: 1. Translate into Tamil: Swachh Bharath Abhiyan was started on October 2nd to honor Mahatma Gandhi's distant vision of clean India. It translates to clean India Mission. This campaign was administered by Govt. of India. This drive was formulated to cover the citizens live in the cities, towns, and rural areas to make them clean. This mission set a lot of objectives to achieve so that India could become cleaner and better. Swachh Bharath Abhiyan is serving as a great initiative in making people aware of the importance of cleanliness. One of the most common problems seen in rural areas is that of open defecation. Generally, in rural area people do not have proper toilet facilities so that they use fields and side of the roads as toilets. This creates a lot of hygiene problems. This clean India Mission can be of great help to improve the living conditions of rural population. Definitely it is going to eradicate unhygienic conditions in India.
